title: Wire Lower Bounds for Gates of Fan-In N1−δ
content: A language in \(\mathrm{ENP}\) needs \(c(\delta)N\sqrt{\log N}\) wires in circuits, unambiguous circuits and integer tensor networks over gates of fan-in \(N^{1-\delta}\), and a language in \(\mathsf{S_2E}\) needs \(2^{N-N^{1-\delta}}/16\); the P versus NP problem remains open.
